### Observed differences

- Two activities that never appeared in the earlier window (0 of 200 traces each) occur regularly in the later window: A02 in about 56 in 100 traces, always as the final event of its trace, and A01 in about 15 in 100 traces, at roughly seven-tenths through the trace. [OCC001, OCC002, POS001, POS002]
- The closing of traces was rerouted through A02. In the earlier window A16 (about 20 in 100 traces) and A19 (about 29 in 100) were always the last event and showed no outgoing transitions; in the later window they sit at about 85% through the trace, and every observed succession from A16 (30 of 30) and from A19 (44 of 44) goes to A02. [POS007, POS008, DIR006, DIR008]
- A01 now sits between A10/A17 and A16: A10 and A17, which earlier sent about 52 and 31 in 100 of their outgoing transitions to A16, now send about 42 and 50 in 100 to A01, and A01 in turn always leads to A16; the observed A10–A16 distance stretched from mostly one step to two or four steps. [DIR001, DIR005, DIR007, LAG007]
- The fragment around A09 shrank and was rewired. A09 fell from about 37 to 20 in 100 traces (repetition from about 26 to 8 in 100) and its typical position moved from about a quarter to about six-tenths through the trace; A13 fell from about 23 to 8 in 100 traces. A07, which earlier split its outgoing transitions about equally between A03 and A09, now sends about half to A14 and none observed to A09; A03 gained a new edge to A09 (about 19 in 100 of its outgoing transitions) while its edge to A08 shrank from about 19 to under 4 in 100; A09 now continues to A02 (about half) or A13 (about half) instead of A13 or A14; and A14 now occurs earlier (about two-tenths vs four-tenths through the trace) and often without A09 (co-occurrence about 37 to 13 in 100 traces). [OCC003, OCC004, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, POS003, POS006, REL011, REL013]
- Pairwise distances shifted consistently with this rewiring: A07–A14 gaps are mostly one step in the later window versus two to four before, A03–A14 gaps two or four steps versus three or five before, and A07–A09 gaps two or four steps versus mostly one before. [LAG002, LAG003, LAG005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that two activities absent from the earlier window now take part in the later window and reshape the end of the process: A02 as a new closing step, and A01 between A10/A17 and A16. Earlier, A02 and A01 were never observed and traces ended at activities such as A16 and A19, which were always the last event with no observed successors; in the later window A02 closes about 56 in 100 traces, always as the final event, reached directly from A16, A19 and A09, while A01 (about 15 in 100 traces) receives the transitions A10 and A17 earlier sent to A16 and always leads on to A16. The support is direct and consistent across all indicator families: participation rose from zero, successor profiles changed exactly on these edges, A02 holds a constant last position while A16 and A19 moved back from the end, and the relation items show A01 before A16, and A02 after A16, A19 or A09, only in the later window. All 42 qualified items belong to the control-flow family, against 0.44 expected for that family without change, so chance cannot account for the volume, and A02's presence in 113 of 200 traces rules out a rare-variant fluke. [OCC001, OCC002, DIR001, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, POS002, POS007, POS008, REL001, REL002, REL008]

The evidence cannot show whether A02 replaced some other, unobserved ending or was purely appended, since no qualified items cover the outgoing transitions of activities such as A14 or A15; the rerouting shares for A10 and A17 also rest on only about 33 and 32 observed transitions, so those exact shares are uncertain. [DIR005, DIR007]

Other differences: the A09/A13 fragment was executed less often and partly bypassed — A09 participation fell from about 37 to 20 in 100 traces with repetition down from about 26 to 8 in 100, A13 fell from about 23 to 8 in 100 traces, A07 now leads to A14 where it earlier led to A09, A03 gained a direct edge to A09, and A14 now typically runs early in the trace and often without A09. [OCC003, OCC004, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, POS006, REL011, REL013]
